item.text: {"iteration":6,"pcvs":[{"name":"running_requests","expression":"len(self.running)","rationale":"Captures per-request decode scheduling work."},{"name":"waiting_requests","expression":"len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting)","rationale":"Captures per-request admission work."},{"name":"has_waiting_requests","expression":"int(bool(self.waiting or self.skipped_waiting))","rationale":"Separates fixed admission-path costs from decode-path costs."},{"name":"small_admission_adjustment","expression":"(4 - len(self.waiting) - len(self.skipped_waiting)) if 0 < len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) <= 2 else 0","rationale":"Combines the two exceptional small-admission states into one feature, assigning singleton and pair batches values of three and two."}],"hypothesis":"The small-batch excess costs are approximately in a three-to-two ratio.
